1.search: 1. Introduction OxSteed LLC provides local service listings, jobs and bids, business workspaces, food ordering, delivery, media, and related account and payment tools. This policy describes information processed when you use these features, including guest contact and support. Availability depends on the feature, account, region, and service provider.

2.search: 2. Information We Collect We process information you provide: contact and account details, profile and business information, job and order details, messages, support requests, reviews, uploaded media, payment records, and verification information where required. We also process device and request information, such as IP addresses, browser details, security logs, and consented usage events. Location may come from an address you enter, your profile, or device permission. Payment providers may collect payment credentials directly.

3.search: 3. How We Use Your Information We use information to operate accounts and workspaces; match jobs and services; fulfill orders; deliver messages and notifications; process and reconcile payments; handle support, disputes, and privacy requests; prevent abuse; and meet legal obligations. Optional analytics helps us understand usage. If you use AI-assisted features, your prompt and relevant feature context may be sent to the configured AI provider to produce a response. Avoid submitting unnecessary sensitive information; AI output can be inaccurate.

4.search: 4. How We Share Your Information Information is disclosed to the participants and businesses needed to provide your requested service, authorized staff, and service providers for payments, hosting and storage, content delivery and security, email or other notifications, maps, and AI features. Integrations include Stripe and Cloudflare; other providers depend on the feature and configuration. Public profiles, listings, reviews, and published media are visible to their intended audience. Legal disclosures and business transfers may also require sharing. Optional analytics or advertising integrations are described in the Cookie Policy.

5.search: 5. Address Privacy and Data Masking Job location visibility depends on your role, assignment, schedule, and the applicable access checks. Order and delivery details are shared with the business and participants who need them for fulfillment. Information you place in public descriptions, photos, reviews, or media may reveal an address even when structured address fields are restricted. Do not publish private addresses or access instructions in public content.

6.search: 6. Data Retention Retention varies by record and purpose. Account, order, message, security, and media records have different lifecycles. Financial ledgers, payment and settlement records, consent evidence, and audit history may remain after account closure for accounting, disputes, fraud prevention, and legal obligations. Deletion may be delayed by active work, held funds, disputes, required audit evidence, or backup lifecycles. We do not promise that closing an account immediately erases every record or third-party copy.

7.search: 7. Your Rights Depending on applicable law, you may request access, correction, deletion, portability, limits on sensitive information use, or an opt-out of sale, sharing, or targeted advertising. You may contact privacy@oxsteed.com or use /do-not-sell without signing in. We may verify identity for access or deletion and explain any applicable exceptions. We will handle requests within applicable legal deadlines and will not discriminate for exercising privacy rights.

8.search: 8. Cookies and Tracking Technologies Essential cookies and browser storage support sign-in, security, consent choices, and requested features. Manage Cookies controls optional analytics, marketing, and additional functional integrations in this browser. Analytics may include first-party pageview events and Google Analytics; marketing may include Meta Pixel when configured. Basic settings and drafts may use browser storage independently of optional integrations. See the Cookie Policy for controls and limitations.

9.search: 9. Data Security and Breach Notification We use access controls, password hashing, session protections, validation, rate limits, and security logging. No system is completely secure. Coverage depends on the service and configuration; this policy does not certify every data store or third-party service. If an incident requires notice, we will notify affected people and authorities as required by applicable law. See /security for reporting guidance.

10.search: 10. Account Deletion Request account deletion through available account settings or privacy@oxsteed.com. Deletion can remove or anonymize personal fields while retaining necessary transaction and audit records. Active obligations may need resolution first. Copies already received by other users or providers are subject to their own obligations. Contact us for the scope and status of your request.
